$comment: D-OPT-SQLITE-FPCONV1-RELEASE-FP-MISCOMPILE runtime witness (the minimized sqlite fpconv1 `dtostr` shape). A double promoted by Mem2Reg + SPILLED across an external call (atoi) is passed as a variadic printf arg; on SysV AMD64 the spilled FP vararg is a SpillSlotRef (c77 D-AS-REGALLOC-DIRECT-ARG-RELOAD). The reload into xmm0 was always correct; the bug was the AL vector-count (SysV §3.5.7) — step-13.4 re-scanned post-regalloc operands for LirRegClass::FPR and skipped the non-Reg SpillSlotRef, stamping AL=0, so glibc's variadic prologue (test al,al) skipped saving xmm0-7 and %f read garbage (printed 0.000). FIX (lir_callconv.cpp materializeOneFunc): count the vector-count at the arg-PLACEMENT decision (residency-independent), so a spilled FP vararg counts identically to a live FPR Reg. The RELEASE arm is load-bearing: only Mem2Reg makes r span the call + spill (debug keeps r in memory). RED-ON-DISABLE (x86_64 elf, release): the residency re-scan prints 0.000 (AL=0). arm64 (AAPCS64, no AL) + ms_x64 (FP-dup, no AL) + debug legs already print 3.125; gcc -std=c17 cross-checked.
